summary: Provide Math.random through a realm-scoped non-cryptographic PRNG contract.

target.notes: Return positive-sign Number in [0,1), approximately uniform; distinct realms need distinct successive sequences.

caveats: Do not promise deterministic cross-runtime sequences.
A process-global RNG may violate the distinct-realm sequence requirement.

tests.name: finite
tests.expected_behavior: prints true; no cryptographic guarantee is implied
